name: n8n-nodes-spurvik
description: Step function for n8n and Make.com workflows. It prepends an AI interaction notice, builds an HMAC-SHA256 receipt of the input, designed to support Article 12 record-keeping, and on the ask_human() gate step sends Approve / Block links that carry Spurvik's own approval-link token on Slack, Telegram, Discord, Microsoft Teams, Linear, Jira, and Asana. Email (Resend): use 1.0.5 once released (planned). Monday.com creates an item for the request, designed to support Article 14 human oversight. n8n's execution history keeps node inputs and outputs. A native n8n node is (planned, 1.0.2).
